title: Palantir CEO Alex Karp Says Anthropic's Dario Amodei Isn't the 'Caricature' Most Americans Think— but Still Calls AI Rivals 'Wildly Unlikable'
excerpt: Palantir Technologies Inc. CEO Alex Karp defended Anthropic chief Dario Amodei during a company all-hands meeting, even while continuing to criticize rival A...

Palantir Technologies Inc. CEO Alex Karp defended Anthropic chief Dario Amodei during a company all-hands meeting, even while continuing to criticize rival AI labs.

"I've spent a lot of time with Dario," Karp said in the company's all-hands meeting that aired Friday, adding Amodei is "not the caricature that many people, most Americans, believe."

Praise Comes Amid Broader Criticism of Rivals

Karp's defense of Amodei came even as he called competing AI firms "wildly unlikable," accusing them of dodging questions on using clients' intellectual property to train models that later compete against those same clients.

  • Still Learning the Market? These 50 Must-Know Terms Can Help You Catch Up Fast

The unconventional billionaire co-founder said the critique reflects enterprise customers' concerns, not his own opinion. Amodei has previously issued his own warnings, writing in a January essay that AI could trigger an unprecedented labor market shock.

Karp has repeatedly criticized "tokenmaxxing," previously likening excessive AI spending to addiction. He said clients question paying for tokens producing "slop." Earlier, he said Palantir built an internal tool to wean enterprises off compulsive token overconsumption.

In a July CNBC "Squawk Box" interview, Karp said "something has gone completely wrong" with the OpenAI and Anthropic Inc. token-based model, denying he was "throwing shade" at the companies. He said enterprises are shifting toward return-on-investment-focused, lower-cost open-weight models instead.

Trending: Avoid the #1 Investing Mistake: How Your 'Safe' Holdings Could Be Costing You Big Time

Karp's latest comments underscore a consistent pattern. While he speaks positively about individual AI leaders such as Amodei on a personal level, he remains deeply critical of the broader AI industry's business practices.

Building Wealth Across More Than Just the Market

Building a resilient portfolio means thinking beyond a single asset or market trend. Economic cycles shift, sectors rise and fall, and no one investment performs well in every environment. That's why many investors look to diversify with platforms that provide access to real estate, fixed-income opportunities, precious metals, and even self-directed retirement accounts. By spreading exposure across multiple asset classes, it becomes easier to manage risk, capture steady returns, and create long-term wealth that isn't tied to the fortunes of just one company or industry.

Palantir Technologies Inc. 首席执行官 Alex Karp 在公司全体会议上为 Anthropic 首席执行官 Dario Amodei 辩护，同时继续批评竞争对手的人工智能实验室。

卡普在周五播出的公司全体会议上表示：“我花了很多时间和达里奥在一起。”他还补充道，阿莫迪“并不是很多人、大多数美国人所认为的讽刺漫画”。

在对竞争对手更广泛的批评中出现赞扬

卡普为阿莫代辩护，尽管他称竞争的人工智能公司“非常不讨人喜欢”，指责他们回避使用客户知识产权来训练模型的问题，这些模型随后将与这些客户竞争。

这位非传统的亿万富翁联合创始人表示，批评反映了企业客户的担忧，而不是他自己的观点。 阿莫迪此前曾发出自己的警告，在一月份的一篇文章中写道，人工智能可能引发前所未有的劳动力市场冲击。

卡普曾多次批评“tokenmaxshing”，此前他将过多的人工智能支出比作成瘾。 他表示，客户质疑支付代币会产生“溢出”。 早些时候，他表示 Palantir 建立了一个内部工具来帮助企业摆脱强迫性的代币过度消费。

在 7 月份接受 CNBC“Squawk Box”采访时，卡普表示 OpenAI 和 Anthropic Inc. 的基于代币的模型“完全出了问题”，并否认他在“给这些公司带来阴影”。 他表示，企业正在转向注重投资回报、成本较低的开放权重模式。

卡普的最新评论强调了一个一致的模式。 虽然他在个人层面上积极评价 Amodei 等人工智能领导者，但他仍然对更广泛的人工智能行业的商业实践持强烈批评态度。

不仅仅在市场上创造财富

建立有弹性的投资组合意味着超越单一资产或市场趋势的思维。 经济周期发生变化，行业兴衰，没有一项投资在所有环境下都能表现良好。 这就是为什么许多投资者希望通过提供房地产、固定收益机会、贵金属甚至自我管理退休账户的平台来实现多元化。 通过将风险分散到多个资产类别，可以更轻松地管理风险、获得稳定的回报并创造不只与一家公司或行业的命运挂钩的长期财富。
